LanguageData.PPTE2_Motivation.label: motivation
LanguageData.PPTE2_Motivation.description: How motivated this prisoner is to work. Motivation rises when supervised, well-fed and paid; it falls when neglected. Prisoners with low motivation refuse to work.
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonerJoy.label: recreation
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonerJoy.description: This prisoner's need for recreation. It falls over time and is restored when the prisoner entertains themselves; using recreation buildings costs meal tickets.
